👥 Roles & Access

👑
Owner
Full Access
✅ View all data   ✅ Edit everything   ✅ Change prices/costs   ✅ Delete records   ✅ Export data   ✅ Change settings   ✅ Manage PINs
📋
Manager
Manage Access
✅ View all data   ✅ Add/edit stock   ✅ Manage customers   ✅ Record transactions   ✅ Manage deliveries   ❌ Cannot change prices   ❌ Cannot delete records   ❌ No settings access
👷
Worker
Limited Access
✅ Add new sarees   ✅ Add customers   ✅ Record advance/payment/pending from customers   ✅ Add & update deliveries   ❌ Cannot see amounts/prices   ❌ Cannot delete   ❌ No financial data   ❌ No settings
